title: Ducts.
officialText:
Ducts and plenums serving Type II hoods shall be constructed of rigid metallic materials. Duct construction,
installation, bracing and supports shall comply with Chapter 6. Ducts subject to positive pressure and ducts conveying moisture-laden
or waste-heat-laden air shall be constructed, joined and sealed in an approved manner.
